description: This source file contains the class definition for `CasesQuickCreate`, a PHP class that extends `QuickCreate` to handle the creation of 'Case' records via a quick create form in the SuiteCRM system. It manages form processing, JavaScript setup, and form rendering logic for the quick create interface.

classes.name: CasesQuickCreate
classes.description: A PHP class for handling the quick creation of 'Case' records within the SuiteCRM system, extending the `QuickCreate` class and adding specific form processing and JavaScript setup.
